# Showcase

Dark versions of five profile stats tools, generated once by `.github/workflows/showcase.yml` on `main`. Each page shows the options next to every image, so a chosen one can be set up for the profile README.

- [cicirello/user-statistician](user-statistician/)
- [jstrieb/github-stats](github-stats/)
- [stats-organization/github-stats-extended](github-stats-extended/)
- [yoshi389111/github-profile-3d-contrib](3d-contrib/)
- [gh-metrics/metrics](gh-metrics/)

An image that failed to generate shows up broken; the workflow run's log says why.
